label: meanWeightsAlpha: every counted pixel weighs the same, so a faint pixel pulls the mean as hard as an opaque one
meanSkipsTransparent: fully transparent pixels are counted, so they thin the mean's alpha
find: guard let pixel = read(x + dx, y + dy), pixel.a > 0 else { continue }
replace: guard let pixel = read(x + dx, y + dy) else { continue }

label: squareIsCentred: the square runs from n/2 instead of -(n/2), so it reads a pixel off the point
hexRounds: each channel is truncated instead of rounded
